Rocky II
Underdog Philadelphia fighter Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) gets another shot at heavyweight champ Apollo Creed. Starring Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young.
PAW Patrol: The Movie

When their biggest rival, Humdinger, starts wreaking havoc as the mayor of Adventure City, Ryder and everyone's favorite heroic pups kick into high gear to face the challenge. Starring Iain Armitage, Marsai Martin, Ron Pardo.
PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie

The PAW Patrol pups magically gain superpowers after a meteor strikes Adventure City. However, things take a turn for the worse when Humdinger and a mad scientist steal their powers and turn themselves into supervillains. Starring Kristen Bell, James Marsden, Mckenna Grace.
The Mummy Returns
The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror. Starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah.
Sinners

Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back. Starring Michael B. Jordan, Hailee Steinfeld, Miles Caton.
All the Old Knives

When the CIA discovers one of its agents leaked information that cost more than 100 people their lives, veteran operative Henry Pelham is assigned to root out the mole with his former lover and colleague Celia Harrison. Starring Chris Pine, Thandiwe Newton, Laurence Fishburne.
Evil Dead Burn

After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one. Starring Souheila Yacoub, Tandi Wright, Hunter Doohan.
Dracula

When a 15th-century prince denounces God after the loss of his wife he inherits an eternal curse. He becomes Dracula. Condemned to wander the centuries, he defies fate and death, guided by a single hope, to be reunited with his lost love. Starring Caleb Landry Jones, Christoph Waltz, Zoë Bleu Sidel.
Dark Side of Comedy
Struggling with addiction and a low self-image, Chris Farley's friends at "Saturday Night Live" conspired to help save him.
Shifting Gears

Motor City mechanic Jess reluctantly agrees to participate in a car restoration show and is shocked to learn that her ex-boyfriend, Luke, is her main competitor. Starring Katherine Barrell, Tyler Hynes, Kristin Booth.
Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Murder in G Major

A new teacher at an Irish prep school is shocked to find a ghost in her house. She decides to help solve his murder in hopes that it will allow him to move on. Starring Tamera Mowry-Housley, Risteard Cooper, Marco Grazzini.
Haunted Harmony Mysteries
Gethsemane and Eamon investigate the death of a sea captain; Tamera Mowry-Housley, Risteard Cooper and Marco Grazzini star.
Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle

When a ghost hunter show comes to town, it's up to Gethsemane and Eamon to solve the unexpected murder of the host, allowing the brand-new spirit to cross over. Starring Adam Fergus, Marco Grazzini, Tamera Mowry-Housley.
Minions: The Rise of Gru

In the 1970s, young Gru tries to join a group of supervillains called the Vicious 6 after they oust their legendary leader. When the interview turns disastrous, Gru and his Minions find themselves on the run with the Vicious 6 hot on their tails. Starring Steve Carell, Pierre Coffin, Alan Arkin.
Sonic the Hedgehog 2
Sonic and his sidekick, Tails, embark on a journey to find a mystical emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. Starring James Marsden, Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz.
Karate Kid: Legends

After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown. Starring Jackie Chan, Ralph Macchio, Ben Wang.
Marry Me

After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. As forces conspire to separate the unlikely newlyweds, they must soon decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love. Starring Jennifer Lopez, Owen Wilson, Chloe Coleman.
Legally Blonde
A sorority queen (Reese Witherspoon) enrolls in Harvard to prove to her former boyfriend that she has more than good looks. Starring Reese Witherspoon, Luke Wilson, Selma Blair.
Mean Girls

Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George. Starring Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Tina Fey.
